correctness.rationale: Analysis isometry maps frame vectors to Pε_j on 1⊥ with P=I−11*/k. Expanding P D_A P D_B P gives exactly [EA,EB]=(v u*−u v*)/k. Its two nonzero imaginary eigenvalues have squared modulus (||u||²||v||²−(u*v)²)/k²=e3(x,y,z,w)/k³. Vanishing equivalently at most two Venn cells nonempty. Under total cell count k, exact smoothing (a,b)→(a−1,b+1) raises e3 by (a−b−1)(c+d) whenever a−b≥2 and c+d>0. Since a maximizer has positive e3 for k≥3, all and only balanced counts maximize. Maclaurin gives upper 1/4 attained only when 4|k. The four fine-grained subset effects form a joint POVM despite nonzero commutator. Independent rational matrix multiplication verified 1344 ordered pairs for k=3..5 and complete integer compositions through k=15; analytic balancing proves arbitrary k.
